source: Derived from Thursday rank snapshots captured by the Data Dawgs Worker (toto) and graded against actual PPR finishes after MNF. Scores only — the underlying third-party ranks are paid content and are never published.
tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
note: No weeks graded yet. The season opens with NFL Week 1 (~Sep 10, 2026); the first grade run is the following Tuesday. `graded` flips to true when Week 1 rows exist. The live document is served by the Worker at GET /rankings/grades and mirrored here at each grade run. This file contains no player-level data of any kind, by design.

method.shrinkage: field + 0.7*(raw-field) until week 10, empirical Bayes after
method.promotion_gate: Pup to Working Dawg only if at least one service pair separates with non-overlapping shrunk CIs on the ALL scope at season end.
